info.name: Partio endpoint contract regression
info.description: Run against a disposable current Partio instance. Creates inactive endpoints using dummy credentials only, checks all provider formats, masking/reveal and masked updates, then deletes each endpoint. No provider network requests.

item.name: completion Ollama: create masks secrets
completion Ollama: normal read stays masked
completion Ollama: explicit reveal
completion Ollama: masked update preserves secrets
completion Ollama: preserved secret after update

exec: pm.test('reveal after update',()=>pm.response.to.have.status(200));const body=pm.response.json();pm.test('masked placeholders preserve stored credentials',()=>{if(body.ApiKey)pm.expect(body.ApiKey).to.eql('dummy-provider-key');if(body.ProviderSettings?.Bedrock)pm.expect(body.ProviderSettings.Bedrock.SessionToken).to.eql('dummy-session-token');});
